Class Game

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.model.Game
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameModel
public class Game extends Object implements GameModel
Reference implementation of GameModel. Aggregates the board, the decks, the players and the current match state, and drives the lifecycle through the placing, drawing, event and end-of-game phases. Mutations are reported to subscribed ModelObserver instances via typed payloads.

      Builds a new game instance.
      Parameters:
      players - players in the match
      board - central board
      tribeDeck - tribe deck used to refill the market
      buildingDeck - building deck used at era progression
      eventResolver - resolver applied during the event phase
      cardMarket - card market exposed to players
      currentEra - starting era
      currentRound - starting round number
